title: UV2 unwrapped by the engine for lightmaps often have parts inverted and breaks normal maps using UV2.
body: ### Tested versions tested in v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4] as well as 4.6.2 stable. ### System information Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9636) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory ### Issue description Setting `Light Baking` property in an imported scene's import settings to `static lightmap` breaks normal maps and generates some inverted islands (such that textures with text in them that are displayed using UV2 are mirrored) I understand that this doesn't really effect Lightmaps since they don't rely on these UVs being correct, but I need to use multiple UV maps in my project and also want to use lightmapping. One of the tasks I need to use the UVs for would work with the Lightmap UVs if they didn't have this bug. ### Steps to reproduce The provided MRP has a mesh with UV2s generated in blender and a shader that us using UV2 to display an albedo texture with text on it and a normal map. 1. Download MRP below. 2. Open the project and open `test_map_scene.tcsn` if it's not already open. 3. Observe that the Normals look correct in the 3D view. 4. Select `MapTest.glb` in the FileSystem dock. 5. Switch to the from the `Scene` tab to the `Import` tab. 6. Set `Light Baking` to `Static Lightmaps` which will generate a UV2 map on the model, overwriting the UV2 map that the model was imported with. 7. Select `Reimport`. 8. In the 3D viewport, Observe broken normals and text that is not just sideways or upside-down, but inverted. Making the imported mesh local and unique and selecting the `Mesh` dropdown from the ribbon bar at the top of the 3D viewport with the `Plane` node selected and then selecting `Unwrap UV2 for lightmap/AO` also has the same bug. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [inverted-lightmap-uvs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28941621/inverted-lightmap-uvs.zip)
